name: atlas-echo
description: Local voice daemon that speaks coding-agent notifications on macOS

scripts.build: D=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/echo-build && bun build adapters/pi/index.ts --target=bun --external @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent --outdir $D/pi && bun build adapters/omp/index.ts --target=bun --external @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent --outdir $D/omp && bun build adapters/mcp/server.ts --target=bun --outdir $D/mcp && bun build adapters/jcode/hook.ts --target=bun --outdir $D/jcode && bun build adapters/grok/hook.ts --target=bun --outdir $D/grok && bun build adapters/codex/hook.ts --target=bun --outdir $D/codex && bun build adapters/opencode/plugin.ts adapters/opencode/reconcile.ts --target=bun --outdir $D/opencode && bun build adapters/empryo/hook.ts adapters/empryo/reconcile.ts --target=bun --outdir $D/empryo
scripts.verify: bun test && bun run smoke && bun run e2e && bun run build
